name: micapet
author: Multimodal Imaging and Connectome Analysis (MICA) Lab
description: MICA-PET is a BIDS-oriented pipeline for static PET processing, including anatomical processing, PET-to-MRI registration, partial-volume correction, SUVR normalization, surface mapping, and quality-control reports.
command-line: mkdir -p [OUTPUT_DIR] && conda run --no-capture-output -n mica-pet python /app/run.py [FASTSURFER_IMAGE] [HIPPUNFOLD_IMAGE] [FS_LICENSE] [PSF] [REF_REGION] [PVC_METHOD] [PVC_MASK] [PVC_N_ITER] [PVC_N_DECONV] [SMOOTHING] [THREADS] [HIPPUNFOLD_CACHE] [EXISTING_FS] [EXISTING_HIPP] [SKIP_HIPP] [NONLINEAR] [EDGE] [FORCE] [BIDS_DATASET] [OUTPUT_DIR] participant --cores [CORES] --participant-label [PARTICIPANT_LABEL] --nolock

inputs.name: BIDS dataset
inputs.description: MICA-PET dataset root containing rawdata/sub-<label>/ses-<label> with anatomical and PET inputs.

inputs.name: Participant label
inputs.description: Participant identifier without the sub- prefix.

inputs.name: FreeSurfer license
inputs.description: FreeSurfer license.txt file.

inputs.name: FastSurfer Singularity image
inputs.description: FastSurfer v2.4.2 SIF image. Required unless existing FastSurfer or FreeSurfer outputs are supplied.

inputs.name: HippUnfold Singularity image
inputs.description: HippUnfold v1.4.1 SIF image. Required unless existing HippUnfold outputs are supplied or HippUnfold is skipped.

inputs.name: Scanner point-spread function
inputs.description: Scanner point-spread-function full width at half maximum in millimetres.

inputs.name: SUVR reference region
inputs.description: Reference region used for SUVR normalization.

inputs.name: Partial-volume correction method
inputs.description: FreeSurfer PETSurfer or PETPVC correction method.

inputs.name: Custom PETPVC mask
inputs.description: Optional 4D NIfTI PETPVC mask in FreeSurfer or FastSurfer space, with one ROI per frame.

inputs.name: Iterative PVC iterations
inputs.description: Number of iterations for iterative PVC methods such as IY.

inputs.name: PVC deconvolution iterations
inputs.description: Number of deconvolution iterations for PVC methods such as RL and VC.

inputs.name: Surface smoothing FWHM
inputs.description: One or more surface smoothing full-width-at-half-maximum values in millimetres.

inputs.name: Threads per processing step
inputs.description: Number of threads exposed to multithreaded processing steps.

inputs.name: Snakemake cores
inputs.description: Maximum number of cores Snakemake may use.

inputs.name: HippUnfold cache directory
inputs.description: Optional existing HippUnfold cache directory.

inputs.name: Existing FreeSurfer or FastSurfer outputs
inputs.description: Existing subject-level FreeSurfer or FastSurfer output directory to reuse instead of running FastSurfer.

inputs.name: Existing HippUnfold outputs
inputs.description: Existing subject and session-level HippUnfold output directory to reuse.

inputs.name: Skip HippUnfold
inputs.description: Skip hippocampal unfolding and hippocampal PET surface outputs.

inputs.name: Nonlinear MNI co-registration
inputs.description: Run nonlinear co-registration to MNI space with LAMAReg.

inputs.name: Edge-based PET registration
inputs.description: Use edge-based PET-to-T1w registration instead of FreeSurfer mri_coreg.

inputs.name: Force reprocessing
inputs.description: Force processing steps to run even when outputs already exist.

output-files.name: MICA-PET output directory
output-files.description: Derivatives, logs, intermediate anatomy products, and quality-control reports generated for the selected participant.

groups.name: FastSurfer source
groups.description: Run FastSurfer from a SIF image or reuse one existing subject output directory.

groups.name: HippUnfold source
groups.description: Run HippUnfold from a SIF image, reuse an existing output directory, or skip hippocampal processing.

error-codes.description: MICA-PET or one of its processing dependencies failed.
